title: Olive Builds a Nest
checkpoint: Phase 1 (Introduction) — a wordless story for sharing and talking through together; there are no sounds to decode yet.
note_for_grown_ups: Watching Olive solve a problem step by step is a great chance to talk about what might come next on each page before you turn it.

pages.talk_prompt: Olive's nest looks a little bare and empty — what do you think she needs to do?
pages.illustration: Olive the plum-coloured owl perched beside a half-built, sparse twig nest high in a tree, looking at the gaps in it.

pages.talk_prompt: Where do you think Olive is flying off to?
pages.illustration: Olive the owl flying through the air holding a single thin brown twig in her beak.

pages.talk_prompt: Olive is weaving the twig into her nest — what do you think the nest needs next?
pages.illustration: Olive the owl carefully weaving a brown twig into the side of her nest, which is already looking fuller.

pages.talk_prompt: Olive has found something soft to add — how do you think it will make the nest feel?
pages.illustration: Olive the owl tucking a soft green leaf and a tuft of moss into the lining of her nest.

pages.talk_prompt: Look how round and full the nest looks now — what do you think Olive will do next?
pages.illustration: Olive the owl stepping back to look at her now round, cosy, finished twig nest.

pages.talk_prompt: Olive is curled up in her nest as it gets dark — how do you think she feels after all that work?
pages.illustration: Olive the owl curled up snugly inside her finished nest at dusk, eyes closed, content.
